subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: Should this PR be the canonical fix for the Telegram over-limit /model callback bug, or should maintainers choose the open sibling implementation instead?
rationale: Both open candidates address the same user-visible bug with different callback contracts, and the selected provider/model callback route affects model-choice behavior.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Land this minimal index-plus-token fallback if maintainers prefer preserving existing name-based callbacks for all models that already fit.

options.title: Use the sibling candidate
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 instead if maintainers prefer its broader indexed callback contract, then pause or close this PR.

options.title: Hold for owner selection
options.body: Keep both candidates open until a Telegram owner explicitly selects the callback format, accepting the extra review round trip.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Land this minimal index-plus-token fallback if maintainers prefer preserving existing name-based callbacks for all models that already fit.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-line blame and callback byte-limit history make steipete the best available routing owner for the callback-format choice.
